name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.278.0 — Lock refuses a shared spec number: /spec:plan's lock step 2 now runs spec-number-check against the host root before any other lint and refuses the lock on exit 1 — a parallel plan that already took this draft's number means the author renames the draft to the next free number and rewrites its AC-IDs by hand, never an auto-renumber. The guard ran only from /spec:doctor check 18 before, so two parallel plans could both lock the same NN and mint the same AC-IDs (class prefix-collision-coverage-fail-open, 5 in the fleet ledger). Pinned by the entrypoint manifest and a lock-time shape test (one draft beside one hardened spec on the same number is refused). 7.277.0 — One tests-row check: lib/file-plan.js exports isTestsRow and every script that decides whether a File Plan row is a tests row calls it, so a row spelled Test is now seen by red-check, ac-matrix and collision-closure the same way build dispatches it; a consistency test bans inline copies. /spec:doctor check 19 (Fixed ports and host command shape) adds two advisory port-check hints: config-compound-boot for a compound runtime.bootCommand and config-no-test-count for a host without capabilities.testCountPattern. 7.276.0 — Queue lanes: a free-text queue item now records which command takes it next — plan, prototype, fix or decide — when it is added, and spec-queue add refuses free text without one. The lane writes the command, so the payload carries the subject only. spec-queue next prints the lane lead above the paste line, and spec-status's Next block prints the same composed line from one shared function. Items added before lanes print as before under a no-lane warning.
